name: @w6w-apps/recurly
description: Manage Recurly accounts, subscriptions, plans, invoices, transactions and coupons via the Recurly V3 API.

w6w.longDescription:
Recurly runs subscription billing and recurring-payment operations for a lot of SaaS and subscription-commerce businesses, and this app lets a workflow act directly on that billing data. Create and look up accounts, list and inspect subscriptions, and drive the subscription lifecycle — create and cancel.

On the money side, list invoices, pull up a specific one, and collect payment against a pending or past-due one. Browse the plan catalog to know what you're billing for, pull the transaction log for a payment attempt, and look up coupons.

Authentication is HTTP Basic with a private API key as the username and an empty password. Every request must also declare the API version it targets — this app pins `v2021-02-25`, Recurly's current GA version.
